snippet.title: Microvania Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a tiny world, get lost, find upgrades, discover hidden paths and battle bosses in this bite-sized retro-style metroidvania action platformer.

Releasing on 24th October 2025.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3114890/Microvania/
